container_create:
set -euo pipefail
ulimit -c 0
unset CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES CUDA_DEVICE_ORDER VITE_MODEL_CATALOG_URL GINFER_MODEL_CATALOG_URL IS_DEV NODE_OPTIONS NODE_ENV FORCE_ONBOARDING FRESH_INSTALL FORCE_HARDWARE_TIER TAURI_CONFIG TAURI_DEV_HOST TAURI_ENV_DEBUG IS_IOS IS_ANDROID IS_CLEAN CARGO_ENCODED_RUSTFLAGS CARGO_BUILD_TARGET RUSTFLAGS
trap 'code=$?; printf "%s\n" "$code" > /work/residency-chain.exit; date -u +%FT%TZ > /work/residency-chain.end' EXIT
date -u +%FT%TZ > /work/residency-chain.start
run_stage() {
  stage="$1"; shift
  date -u +%FT%TZ > "/work/residency-${stage}.start"
  if "$@" > "/work/residency-${stage}.log" 2>&1; then code=0; else code=$?; fi
  printf '%s\n' "$code" > "/work/residency-${stage}.exit"
  date -u +%FT%TZ > "/work/residency-${stage}.end"
  return "$code"
}
run_stage focused-ui yarn test web-app/src/containers/__tests__/EngineHostModels.test.tsx
run_stage focused-manager node --test tests/ginfer-manager-ui.test.mjs
run_stage focused-options cargo test --locked --offline --manifest-path src-tauri/ginfer-host/Cargo.toml residency_options_ -- --test-threads=1
run_stage focused-service cargo test --locked --offline --manifest-path src-tauri/ginfer-host/Cargo.toml profile_and_saved_launches_quote_current_settings_without_persisting_auto_bytes -- --test-threads=1
run_stage check cargo check --locked --offline --manifest-path src-tauri/ginfer-host/Cargo.toml --all-targets
run_stage clippy cargo clippy --locked --offline --manifest-path src-tauri/ginfer-host/Cargo.toml --all-targets
run_stage verify make verify
failure_policy: Stop on first failure; fix and resume only failed and unrun stages; no repeated full verify
source_export: git archive committed source excluding out evidence; refresh tracked regular input mtimes
preparation_note: Metadata refresh initially exceeded SSH argv limit; passed the path list on stdin before any test launch.
launch: nohup taskset -c 80-87 nice -n 10 flock -s /tmp/ginfer-s1-socket1-compile.lock docker start -a c3-host-residency-controls-20261018 > /media/ron/SSD_RAID/ai/tmp-c3-host-residency-controls-20261018/driver.log 2>&1 < /dev/null & echo $!
